title: Merton structural model: asset value, asset volatility and default risk
source:
"""Merton (1974): recover asset value and volatility from equity, then default risk.

Two unknowns (V, sigma_V), two equations: the equity pricing identity and the
volatility link sigma_E E = N(d1) sigma_V V (Ito on E = C(V)). Solving only the
first with an assumed sigma_V is the common shortcut, and it is wrong.

A good starting point makes the joint solve robust: V0 = E + D exp(-rT) (the
balance sheet) and sigma_V0 = sigma_E E / V0 (the leverage-scaled equity vol).
The solve works in (ln V, ln sigma_V) so both stay positive, and the program
refuses to write a firm whose residuals are not tiny relative to its inputs.
"""
import math
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.stats import norm

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/firms.csv"
OUT = "/app/output/merton.csv"


def d1d2(V, sv, D, r, T):
    d1 = (math.log(V / D) + (r + 0.5 * sv * sv) * T) / (sv * math.sqrt(T))
    return d1, d1 - sv * math.sqrt(T)


def solve(E, sE, D, r, T):
    def residual(z):
        V, sv = math.exp(z[0]), math.exp(z[1])
        d1, d2 = d1d2(V, sv, D, r, T)
        return [(V * norm.cdf(d1) - D * math.exp(-r * T) * norm.cdf(d2) - E) / E,
                (norm.cdf(d1) * sv * V - sE * E) / (sE * E)]

    V0 = E + D * math.exp(-r * T)
    z0 = [math.log(V0), math.log(max(sE * E / V0, 1e-4))]
    res = least_squares(residual, z0, xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15, max_nfev=2000)
    V, sv = math.exp(res.x[0]), math.exp(res.x[1])
    assert max(abs(x) for x in residual(res.x)) < 1e-9, "Merton system did not converge"
    return V, sv


def main() -> None:
    firms = pd.read_csv(INPUT)
    rows = []
    for f in firms.itertuples(index=False):
        E, sE, D, T, r = float(f.equity_value), float(f.equity_vol), float(f.debt_face), float(f.maturity_years), float(f.rate)
        V, sv = solve(E, sE, D, r, T)
        _, d2 = d1d2(V, sv, D, r, T)
        rows.append({"firm_id": f.firm_id, "asset_value": V, "asset_vol": sv,
                     "distance_to_default": d2, "default_probability": float(norm.cdf(-d2)),
                     "credit_spread": -math.log((V - E) / D) / T - r})
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    assert (out["asset_value"] > firms["equity_value"]).all()
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_csv(OUT, index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    print(out.describe().T[["min", "max"]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
